title: Inventory information and replenishment choice
x: Availability of a verified inventory signal
y: Selection of an immediate replenishment order
unit: A store manager deciding whether to replenish stock
context: A store manager can place a standard replenishment order now or defer the order until the next scheduled review. In X0 the manager sees only the most recent periodic stock estimate; in X1 the manager also sees a verified current inventory signal. Both actions remain operationally feasible. Explore demand volatility, lead times, and information conditions without changing the focal information contrast.
